sources.snippet: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators Rather Than Generators ELECTRA is a new method for self-supervised language representation learning. It can be used to pre-train transformer networks using relatively little compute.

sources.title: keras/electra_base_generator_uncased_en · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Overview ELECTRA model is a pretraining approach for language models published by Google. Two transformer models are trained, a generator and a discriminator. The generator replaces tokens in a sequence and is trained as a masked language model. The discriminator is trained to discern what tokens have been replaced. This method of pretraining is more efficient than comparable methods ...
